question: As of November 2022, who is the Union Minister for Food Processing Industries in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pashupati Kumar Paras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pashupati Kumar Paras** has been the **Union Minister of Food Processing Industries since November 2022.**
 
• He is a member of the Rashtriya Lok Janshakti Party** and has been a Member of Parliament since 2014.**
 
• He is also the **Minister of State for Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
